source: EPFL terrace1 camera1; public research footage used in edition131
scope: Retrospective AI source-only visual annotations, independent of tracker calculations. Annotator has seen prior aggregate results; not blinded human truth, new trajectories, or held qualification. Every slot retained, including uncertainty. No tuning.
contactConvention: For a grounded walking person, mark midpoint between visible ground-support extremities when both feet contact; otherwise visible planted foot. Do not mark airborne or occluded feet. This differs intentionally from a bounding-box bottom-centre. Pixel uncertainty declared by visual reviewer; not probabilistic.
